description: This file defines the FormattedHeaderFooter class, which manages the rendering and layout logic for headers and footers in a PDF document, including formatting and area provisioning.

classes.name: FormattedHeaderFooter
classes.description: Represents a formatted header or footer for PDF rendering, implementing IAreaProvider to manage layout areas and rendering info.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Configures formatting of the header/footer using graphics context, preparing layout areas and calculating total content height.

methods.name: GetRenderInfos
methods.description: Retrieves the array of RenderInfo objects representing the formatted content, or returns an empty array if none are available.
